stem: A snail moving at a constant rate traveled a distance of 20 inches in \( \frac{1}{2} \) hour. Create a graph to represent \( y \), the number of inches the snail traveled in \( x \) hours. Select two points on the coordinate grid. A line will connect the points.
visual_elements: Coordinate grid with x-axis labeled 'Time (h)' ranging from 0 to 5 and y-axis labeled 'Distance (in.)' ranging from 0 to 120
